008package paint.shared.io.internal;
009
010import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.*;
011
012import paint.shared.objects.Square;
013
014import tech.tablesaw.api.ColumnType;
015import tech.tablesaw.api.Row;
016import tech.tablesaw.api.Table;
017import tech.tablesaw.columns.Column;
018
019import java.util.ArrayList;
020import java.util.List;
021
022/**
023 * Internal schema-validated table I/O implementation for {@link Square}.
024 * <p>
025 * Handles low-level I/O and data conversion between PAINT {@link Square} objects and Tablesaw
026 * {@link Table} structures.
027 * </p>
028 * <p>
029 * The {@code SquaresTableIO} class provides implementation for mapping square entity fields to
030 * CSV columns and vice versa. It manages the schema specific to "squares.csv" files, ensuring
031 * that data types and headers are correctly applied during conversion.
032 * </p>
033 */
034public class SquaresTableIO extends BaseTableIO {
035
036    // =====================================================================
037    //  TABLE CREATION
038    // =====================================================================
039
040    /**
041     * @return a new empty {@link Table} with the Squares schema.
042     */
043    public Table emptyTable() {
044        return newEmptyTable("Squares", Square.Column.values(), c -> c.header, c -> c.type);
045    }
046
047    // =====================================================================
048    //  ENTITY → TABLE CONVERSION
049    // =====================================================================
050
051    /**
052     * Converts a list of {@link Square} entities into a Tablesaw {@link Table}.
053     *
054     * @param squares list of square objects to convert
055     * @return a table containing the square data
056     */
057    public Table toTable(List<Square> squares) {
058        Table table = emptyTable();
059
060        for (Square square : squares) {
061            Row tablesawRow = table.appendRow();
062
063            tablesawRow.setString(  UNIQUE_KEY,                        square.getUniqueKey());
064            tablesawRow.setString(  EXPERIMENT_NAME,                   square.getExperimentName());
065            tablesawRow.setString(  RECORDING_NAME,                    square.getRecordingName());
066            tablesawRow.setInt(     SQUARE_NUMBER,                     square.getSquareNumber());
067            tablesawRow.setInt(     ROW_NUMBER,                        square.getRowNumber());
068            tablesawRow.setInt(     COLUMN_NUMBER,                     square.getColNumber());
069            tablesawRow.setInt(     LABEL_NUMBER,                      square.getLabelNumber());
070            tablesawRow.setInt(     CELL_ID,                           square.getCellId());
071            tablesawRow.setBoolean( VISIBLE,                           square.isVisible());
072            tablesawRow.setBoolean( SQUARE_MANUALLY_EXCLUDED,          square.isSquareManuallyExcluded());
073            tablesawRow.setBoolean( IMAGE_EXCLUDED,                    square.isImageExcluded());
074            tablesawRow.setDouble(  X0,                                square.getX0());
075            tablesawRow.setDouble(  Y0,                                square.getY0());
076            tablesawRow.setDouble(  X1,                                square.getX1());
077            tablesawRow.setDouble(  Y1,                                square.getY1());
078            tablesawRow.setInt(     NUMBER_OF_TRACKS,                  square.getNumberOfTracks());
079            tablesawRow.setDouble(  VARIABILITY,                       square.getVariability());
080            tablesawRow.setDouble(  DENSITY,                           square.getDensity());
081            tablesawRow.setDouble(  DENSITY_RATIO,                     square.getDensityRatio());
082            tablesawRow.setDouble(  DENSITY_RATIO_ORI,                 square.getDensityRatioOri());
083            tablesawRow.setDouble(  TAU,                               square.getTau());
084            tablesawRow.setDouble(  R_SQUARED,                         square.getRSquared());
085            tablesawRow.setDouble(  MEDIAN_DIFFUSION_COEFFICIENT,      square.getMedianDiffusionCoefficient());
086            tablesawRow.setDouble(  MEDIAN_DIFFUSION_COEFFICIENT_EXT,  square.getMedianDiffusionCoefficientExt());
087            tablesawRow.setDouble(  MEDIAN_DISPLACEMENT,               square.getMedianDisplacement());
088            tablesawRow.setDouble(  MAX_DISPLACEMENT,                  square.getMaxDisplacement());
089            tablesawRow.setDouble(  TOTAL_DISPLACEMENT,                square.getTotalDisplacement());
090            tablesawRow.setDouble(  MEDIAN_MAX_SPEED,                  square.getMedianMaxSpeed());
091            tablesawRow.setDouble(  MAX_MAX_SPEED,                     square.getMaxMaxSpeed());
092            tablesawRow.setDouble(  MEDIAN_MEDIAN_SPEED,               square.getMedianMedianSpeed());
093            tablesawRow.setDouble(  MAX_MEDIAN_SPEED,                  square.getMaxMedianSpeed());
094            tablesawRow.setDouble(  MAX_TRACK_DURATION,                square.getMaxTrackDuration());
095            tablesawRow.setDouble(  TOTAL_TRACK_DURATION,              square.getTotalTrackDuration());
096            tablesawRow.setDouble(  MEDIAN_TRACK_DURATION,             square.getMedianTrackDuration());
097        }
098
099        return table;
100    }
101
102    // =====================================================================
103    //  TABLE → ENTITY CONVERSION (UNCHANGED)
104    // =====================================================================
105
106    /**
107     * Converts a Tablesaw {@link Table} into a list of {@link Square} entities.
108     *
109     * @param table the table to convert
110     * @return a list of square objects
111     */
112    public List<Square> toEntities(Table table) {
113        List<Square> squares = new ArrayList<>();
114
115        for (Row row : table) {
116            Square square = new Square();
117
118            square.setUniqueKey(                     row.getString( UNIQUE_KEY));
119            square.setExperimentName(                row.getString( EXPERIMENT_NAME));
120            square.setRecordingName(                 row.getString( RECORDING_NAME));
121            square.setSquareNumber(                  row.getInt(    SQUARE_NUMBER));
122            square.setRowNumber(                     row.getInt(    ROW_NUMBER));
123            square.setColNumber(                     row.getInt(    COLUMN_NUMBER));
124            square.setLabelNumber(                   row.getInt(    LABEL_NUMBER));
125            square.setCellId(                        row.getInt(    CELL_ID));
126            square.setVisible(                       row.getBoolean(VISIBLE));
127            square.setSquareManuallyExcluded(        row.getBoolean(SQUARE_MANUALLY_EXCLUDED));
128            square.setImageExcluded(                 row.getBoolean(IMAGE_EXCLUDED));
129            square.setX0(                            row.getDouble( X0));
130            square.setY0(                            row.getDouble( Y0));
131            square.setX1(                            row.getDouble( X1));
132            square.setY1(                            row.getDouble( Y1));
133            square.setNumberOfTracks(                row.getInt(    NUMBER_OF_TRACKS));
134            square.setVariability(                   row.getDouble( VARIABILITY));
135            square.setDensity(                       row.getDouble( DENSITY));
136            square.setDensityRatio(                  row.getDouble( DENSITY_RATIO));
137            square.setDensityRatioOri(               row.getDouble( DENSITY_RATIO_ORI));
138            square.setTau(                           row.getDouble( TAU));
139            square.setRSquared(                      row.getDouble( R_SQUARED));
140            square.setMedianDiffusionCoefficient(    row.getDouble( MEDIAN_DIFFUSION_COEFFICIENT));
141            square.setMedianDiffusionCoefficientExt( row.getDouble( MEDIAN_DIFFUSION_COEFFICIENT_EXT));
142            square.setMedianDisplacement(            row.getDouble( MEDIAN_DISPLACEMENT));
143            square.setMaxDisplacement(               row.getDouble( MAX_DISPLACEMENT));
144            square.setTotalDisplacement(             row.getDouble( TOTAL_DISPLACEMENT));
145            square.setMedianMaxSpeed(                row.getDouble( MEDIAN_MAX_SPEED));
146            square.setMaxMaxSpeed(                   row.getDouble( MAX_MAX_SPEED));
147            square.setMedianMedianSpeed(             row.getDouble( MEDIAN_MEDIAN_SPEED));
148            square.setMaxMedianSpeed(                row.getDouble( MAX_MEDIAN_SPEED));
149            square.setMaxTrackDuration(              row.getDouble( MAX_TRACK_DURATION));
150            square.setTotalTrackDuration(            row.getDouble( TOTAL_TRACK_DURATION));
151            square.setMedianTrackDuration(           row.getDouble( MEDIAN_TRACK_DURATION));
152
153            squares.add(square);
154        }
155
156        return squares;
157    }
158
159    // =====================================================================
160    //  APPEND / MERGE (UPDATED FOR EMBEDDED SCHEMA)
161    // =====================================================================
162
163    public void appendInPlace(Table target, Table source) {
164        for (Row row : source) {
165            Row newRow = target.appendRow();
166
167            for (Square.Column colEnum : Square.Column.values()) {
168                String col = colEnum.header;
169                Column<?> targetCol = target.column(col);
170
171                if (targetCol.type() == ColumnType.STRING) {
172                    newRow.setString(col, row.getString(col));
173                } else if (targetCol.type() == ColumnType.INTEGER) {
174                    newRow.setInt(col, row.getInt(col));
175                } else if (targetCol.type() == ColumnType.DOUBLE) {
176                    newRow.setDouble(col, row.getDouble(col));
177                } else if (targetCol.type() == ColumnType.BOOLEAN) {
178                    newRow.setBoolean(col, row.getBoolean(col));
179                }
180            }
181        }
182    }
183}
